5.
At the request of the Chairman, the Secretary to the
Commission shall summon once a month a meeting of all
the members of the Commission and the Panel. The quorum
for such meeting shall be five members.

6.
The members of the  Commission and the Panel shall
be remunerated in such amount as shall be determined by
the Minister.
